messages:
maria_cs: Quick post-call notes from PulseHaven onboarding (11:08 PT). They surfaced a set of product asks that affect renewal confidence. Dropping raw convo here for prioritization.

maria_cs: Summary notes: 
- Need per-route spend CSV & per-route trend chart in Console (Finance wants exportable evidence).
- Want control over embedding TTL per-project/route (their vectors age out unpredictably).
- Ability to pin a model version to a route; if pinned model is down, prefer explicit soft-fallback to a compatible variant.
- 429 / throttling guidance is unclear; logs only show generic 429s, they need field-level reason + suggested remediation.
- A simple "first-7-days" onboarding dashboard with usage, latency, and cost to show to their CFO.

maria_cs: Customer verbatim: 
> "Our trial got flagged by finance when embedding spend spiked. We need a way to prove what happened and stop it from happening again."

noah_product: Good capture. Maria, can you paste the exact route name and spike timestamp so ENG can pull traces? Also, TTL: do they mean server-side eviction of stored vectors or a way to flag vectors as stale for downstream indexing?

maria_cs: Route: pulse-search-v1; spike observed 2026-03-14T02:40:12Z. They said embedding calls increased after a scheduled batch job. TTL request = server-side configurable eviction (24h/7d/etc).

alex_se: I'll grab the infra metrics for that window and attach a small grafana snapshot. Short-term workaround: add a route tag and let billing export group by tag so they can show route-level spend to finance.

alex_se: About pin+fallback: backend already supports version pinning via rollout config, but Console lacks a simple toggle. We could expose a lightweight "pin route" toggle that sets rollout weight=100 for selected model.

noah_product: Proposal: split into two workstreams: 1) Cost transparency (per-route metering + CSV export + onboarding 7-day dashboard) = highest priority for renewal. 2) Operational controls (emb TTL + pin UI + improved 429 logs) = secondary. @taylor_pm?

taylor_pm: Agree. Cost visibility directly impacts renewal decisions. Recommend we treat metering + CSV as P0 (2-week ETA) and dashboard as P0.5 (3-week ETA). Operational controls P1/backlog depending on engineering effort.

sam_bot: Created ticket INF-4922: per-route spend CSV (https://jira.redwood/INF-4922).

sam_bot: Created ticket INF-4923: onboarding 7-day dashboard (https://jira.redwood/INF-4923).

alex_se: I'll add the Grafana time-series and a short reproduction snippet (the batch job logs) to INF-4922 by EOD. Note to ENG: check embedding client concurrency + cache TTL for that window; KV cache churn + overlapping batch jobs often causes duplicate embedding calls.

maria_cs: I'll message PulseHaven finance contact and request permission to share their billing sample with ENG. Also offering them the per-route-tag workaround immediately.

noah_product: Can CS supply 2-3 prioritized CSV schemas/use-cases so we scope fields properly? Example fields we think: timestamp, route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_calls, estimated_cost_usd, request_id.

maria_cs: Will DM finance and paste examples here tomorrow AM. Adding note that they need human-readable cost allocations per project and quick totals for the CFO. :thumbsup:

taylor_pm: Owners & tentative ETAs: 
- INF-4922 (per-route CSV + export): owner=noah_product, ETA=2w
- INF-4923 (onboarding 7-day dashboard): owner=taylor_pm, ETA=3w
- Investigate embedding TTL feasibility: owner=alex_se, ETA=investigation->INF-4922 addendum
- Pin-model UI experiment: owner=pm-ui-team, ETA=Q3 (add minimal toggle as short experiment if low-cost)

maria_cs: Action summary for CS: communicate tickets + ETAs to PulseHaven; get finance sample CSV; ask them if they'd accept temporary tagging workaround while we build CSV export. Owner: maria_cs, due: tomorrow EOD.

noah_product: Thanks. Keep focused updates here. If the finance sample shows unusual patterns, we may accelerate emb-TTL investigation.

sam_bot: Thread archived after 90 days per retention policy.
